issues.decision: Replace the broad wear card with NHTSA campaign 00V-421002's exact lower-ball-joint condition and remedy.

evidence.label: NHTSA Campaign 00V-421002 - Chrysler Sebring Lower Ball Joint

trims: Sebring vehicles included in NHTSA campaign 00V-421002; confirm applicability by VIN
after.title: Lower Lateral-Arm Ball Joint Can Wear and Separate (Recall 00V-421)
after.description: NHTSA campaign 00V-421002 includes certain 1995-2000 Chrysler Sebring vehicles. A damaged ball-joint boot or another moisture path can allow dirt and water into the lower lateral-arm ball joint. The ball stud can corrode and the joint can wear beyond tolerance, increasing the risk of separation and loss of vehicle control.
after.solution: Check the VIN for campaign 00V-421002 before ordering suspension parts. Dealers inspect the lower lateral-arm ball joints for wear. A joint beyond tolerance is replaced with the newly designed lateral-arm ball-joint assembly; a joint within tolerance is cleaned and sealed against moisture intrusion. If looseness, clunking, steering change, or visible boot damage is present, stop driving and arrange professional inspection.
symptoms: Lower ball joint wear or separation

citations.title: NHTSA Campaign 00V-421002 - Chrysler Sebring Lower Ball Joint

after.contentUpdateSummary: Replaced the fifteen-year control-arm/bushing aggregation with recall 00V-421002's exact 1995-2000 ball-joint moisture mechanism, inspection threshold, and dealer remedy.
